data.name: Basna
data.gender_notes: Basna is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'Basanah', meaning 'to touch gently' or 'to examine carefully'. This name evokes images of tenderness, grace, and thoughtfulness in Islamic culture. The name Basna carries the meaning “Gentle, delicate” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Basna usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle, delicate and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the gentle touch of Allah's mercy and love.
data.etymology: Basna belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gentle, delicate.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Basna total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
